name: State Farm
notes: APPRAISAL 10-DAY RULE: Newer State Farm forms (HW-21xx, FE-5626 endorsement) require written, ITEMIZED documentation of each disputed item to be received at least 10 days BEFORE an appraisal demand. State Farm rejects demands sent sooner. The clock runs from State Farm's receipt of the itemized notice, NOT from the reinspection decision. (1) Always send reinspection requests with the 'Reinspection Request + Itemized Dispute Notice' template. (2) Save proof of receipt. (3) Send the demand no earlier than day 12 after receipt, using the '10-Day-Compliant Appraisal Demand' template. If a demand is rejected as premature, re-serve the same day if 10+ days have passed since receipt. Escalate Michigan files (Hart v. State Farm). See KB: State Farm's 10-Day Pre-Appraisal Notice Rule.
